source.note: AMU Department of Computer Science, MCA (Master of Computer Applications), batch 2024-26, semesters 1-3. Shared by Mohd Rameez Khan. Courses live under Faculty-of-Science/MCA/Sem<N>/ (electives under Faculty-of-Science/MCA/Electives/); use find_courses. Each top folder names its course code, e.g. '1 - CAMS-1001 - Data Structure Using C++' = CAMS1001; CAMS-2E06 E-Commerce, CAMS-2E09 Web Based Programming, CAMS-3E02 Network Programming, CAMS-3E08 AI and Soft Computing and STM-4091 Applied Statistics are electives. 'PYQ'S' = question papers; 'From Seniors' and 'From BCA' are older students' notes for the same course; 'Copy Notes' are handwritten notes; 'Lab Assignments' / 'Lab Work' / 'Mini Project' are students' own programs and project files (keep code as code files in Records). 'Books' folders hold published books: not ours to publish. 'Course Layout (Swayam)' and Swayam playlists are NPTEL/Swayam material (a link is fine, not the course's own).
